items.text: Future Career School offers career counselling for seniors and retirement-age adults who want to stay professionally active, through consulting, advisory, teaching, or mentoring work, instead of starting a job search built for someone decades younger.
Sessions run fully online across India, so joining does not depend on travel, a nearby office, or comfort with anything more complicated than a simple video call.

This starts from a high-value skill portfolio built over decades, and a realistic route to unlocking income opportunities from it, instead of a job-search template that assumes a different stage of life entirely.
